notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: Improved stability, fixed a few bugs. Notably, that one where Ludo wasn't launching on Macs.

notes.title: Ludo Online update released
notes.content:
A small update should download for everybody. It is now finally possible to get the "Jailkeeper" achievement. Previously it was impossible. Thanks to Syzygy for reporting this!

Other than that I've fixed some small bugs and updated game libraries. Suggestions for features and improvements are always welcome at ludo-online@cytec.bg

notes.title: 0.6.0 Christmas Update - New Hats and Board skins
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added Christmas board skins. The Christmas skins can be selected when creating a room. Works for all boards (2-6 players).
[*] Christmas hats are in! There are six new hats (free of course). Launch the game and check them out.
[*] Room list is now automatically updated when multiplayer rooms are created and deleted. No need to spam the "refresh" button anymore.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Better error messages when game files are missing from the filesystem.
[*] Fixed a crash when launching the game with corrupted image files.
[*] Some other bugzies too small to notice or too difficult to explain.
[/list]

Merry Christmas and happy new year,
Peter

notes.title: 0.5.2 Changelog
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]

- Window size can be selected from a list of predefined resolutions in settings.
- Idle timer can now be disabled in multiplayer games. When creating a game select "No idle timeout" in the idle time select.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed a crash when joining via Steam invitation with slow internet connection
- Fixed de-syncing issues with slow internet connection
- Added loading states on buttons
- Added waiting popup when joining via Steam invitation
- "Enter" key now works on the "password join" screen
- A message is displayed when trying to join a room that no longer exists

notes.title: 0.5.0 Changelog
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]

- Added blockades. A square forms a blockade if it contains two pieces of the same color. A blockade can only be passed by opponents by throwing one or six.
- Added Halloween board skins. The Halloween skin can be selected when creating a room.
- Pawns can now wear hats! To select which hat to equip, click on the icon above your avatar when in game.
- Added Steam achievements.
- When a multiplayer room is created you can now specify how much time the game will wait for a player to make a move.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

- Added scroll to the chatbox
- Fixed missing sound effects on some OSX installs
- An error message is now displayed when the graphics driver doesn't support OpenGL
- Updated all 3rd party libraries to their latest versions
- Fixed crashes and instabilities

notes.title: Ludo Online update released
notes.content:
A small update to Ludo Online is now available:

[list]
[*] Adjusted UI scaling on Windows.
[*] Game will now use discrete GPU on laptops instead of integrated one.
[*] Fixed missing audio errors.
[*] Fixed IPV6 networking issues.
[*] Fixed crash after setting fullscreen on OSX and restarting.
[/list]
